rules: The pages live in test/pages and are served by test/server.mjs. Never measure against production.

systemDecisions.title: Fields and buttons are at least 44 px tall and use 16 px text
systemDecisions.why: The field is 30 px tall with 13 px text, and the button next to it is 36 px. Fixed one at a time, they end up at different heights again.
systemDecisions.proposal: One shared height of 44 px and 16 px text for every field and button.

fixes.title: The form does not say what went wrong
fixes.finding: When an address without a domain is sent, the page comes back without an error message, the field is empty and nothing is marked. A double click sends the form twice.
evidence: measurement.json: formGaps = 3 and doubleSubmits = 1 on faults-form
fixes.change: Show the error next to the field with role="alert", set aria-invalid on the field, keep what was typed, and lock the button after the first press.

fixes.title: The email field makes the iPhone zoom in
fixes.finding: The field has 13 px text. The iPhone zooms in on fields under 16 px, and the page sits askew when the keyboard closes.
fixes.change: Set the field's text to 16 px and its height to 44 px.

fixes.title: The send button does not respond when pressed
fixes.finding: The button looks the same before, during and after a press. The user is not told that the press was seen.
evidence: measurement.json: noPressed on faults lists button.btn
fixes.change: Give the button a pressed state.

variants.name: Calm
variants.what: The button turns a shade darker while it is held down. No motion.

variants.name: Medium
variants.what: The button turns darker and shrinks by 3 % over 120 ms. Under "reduce motion" only the colour changes.

variants.name: Clear
variants.what: Like B, and the button lightens under the mouse before it is pressed, so it shows that it can be pressed.
